title: The Empty Confession
author: Petra Fairweather
blurb: Sable Ishikawa, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
